models.tk_meta: Three things run quietly for every brain: read-only tool results are kept for a few minutes (same arguments means no second POS/ads call; any write to that connection clears its cache), JSON data is compacted while keeping every number, and the most-used tools are shown directly instead of hidden behind search. Tune in settings: mcp.dem_doc_giay (default 180, 0 = off), mcp.nen_ket_qua, mcp.tool_nong (default 12). For API brains two more: long tool results are stored whole in a file (the brain pages through it, nothing in the middle is lost), and old tool results within a turn are cleared once the conversation exceeds mcp.don_ngu_canh_ky_tu (default 240,000 chars, 0 = off), with the marker pointing to the full file.

ol.dk_title: Three steps, on the SERVER itself, not in MinMin's terminal
ol.dk_b1: SSH into the VPS as root. MinMin's own terminal will not do: it runs inside the container, has no root, and anything installed there is wiped on the next update.
ol.dk_b3: Make Ollama listen on the Docker bridge address. Only containers on this host can reach it and nothing is exposed to the Internet, so no firewall step is needed:
ol.dk_b4: The address is already filled in below - just press Connect:
ol.dk_canh_bao: The command above binds Ollama to an internal address, so no firewall is needed. Only if you must use OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0 (unusual Docker network) does Ollama listen to the whole Internet, and it has NO password: run ufw allow from THE-BRIDGE-SUBNET to any port 11434 then ufw deny 11434, or block port 11434 in your VPS provider's firewall.
ol.dk_cham: A VPS usually has no GPU and little RAM, so a CPU-bound model will be very slow. Your desktop at home (with a GPU, ideally) is the better host, at the cost of the VPS having to reach it.
ol.dk_khong_do_duoc: MinMin could not work out the host address. Run the command below on the host, then put the number that follows the word default into the box above, with :11434 after it.
ol.dk_chan_doan: Still not connecting? On the host run: ss -ltnp | grep 11434. No line means Ollama is not running (see systemctl status ollama). A line with 127.0.0.1 means step 3 has not been done.

It only reports when something new happens: the page changes, the text you are waiting for appears, or a price drops below your threshold. rp.auto_note: The bot weighs each group message on its own, with nothing to configure: it works out who is being addressed, reads the last few messages and checks them against the Agent's role and the bot's documents. It learns as it goes from how the group reacts and from your Right/Wrong buttons (the "..." menu on the bot card, Reply judge). To learn, it keeps the group's chat text: up to 400 characters per message for 14 days, and learned cases for 180 days. Forget all wipes it. In private 1-1 chats the bot's own Agent chooses to reply, stay silent, or stay silent and alert you in the bell on a hard question; private chats are not in the statistics and are not learned from.
